name: Marriage Separation
overview: Scripture affirms the sacredness of marriage as a divine institution, highlighting the blessing found in a godly union and warning against the harm of separation. The Lord expresses His hatred for putting away a spouse, cautioning believers to guard their hearts against treachery in marriage. Jesus teaches that divorce is permissible only on the basis of fornication, and that divorcing without this cause leads to adultery, underscoring the permanence intended in marriage from creation. These passages collectively emphasize faithfulness and caution in the handling of marital separation.
